messages.subject: 5-a-side Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
Hey — are you around for 5-a-side on Thursday after work? We're one short and the pitch is booked for 6:30 at the Bishopsgate courts. Drinks after at the Crown. Let me know.

Tom

(Sorry if this is the wrong Elena — meant the one in Disputes!)
